description: This file defines the BurpproOutputProcessor class, which processes XML files containing vulnerability issues from Burp Suite reports. It converts HTML descriptions to Markdown, filters specific issues, and constructs vulnerability objects to produce a processing result.

classes.name: BurpproOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes XML vulnerability reports from Burp Suite, extracting issues and converting them into vulnerability objects.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads an XML file, filters and converts vulnerabilities, and returns a ProcessorResult containing the parsed vulnerabilities.
